baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construct ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ assigns the sky at word 1 an abiding return-process at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: The upper cover includes cloud and rain, while الرجْع includes recurrent rain and water; together they make the sky a circulating source rather than a static ceiling.

activation_trace.role: The overhead cover explicitly extends to cloud and rain, supplying the upper material pole of the circuit.
Cyclic rain and returning water supply the literal recurrence that the sky possesses.

changed_reading.before: The sky has an unspecified property called return.
changed_reading.after: The sky-cloud system is characterized by recurrent water, an overhead circuit that repeatedly gives back what has circulated.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same construct joins an overhead covering at word 1 to a noun of repeated sound at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: An upper cover can function as a resonant vault, and the sound branch of الرجْع makes recurrence audible as echo, modulated call, or thunder.

activation_trace.role: The upper covering supplies the spatial surface or vault against which recurrence can be heard.
Repeated sound, including call and thunder, turns return into an acoustic event.

changed_reading.before: Return is only movement or rainfall.
changed_reading.after: The sky is also an echoing canopy, distinguished by sounds or signals that come back in repetition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessed noun الرجْع can denote both return and causing something to return, while السماء names what is above and covers.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sky can be read as an active interface: motion reaches the upper boundary and is sent back toward a prior place or state.

activation_trace.role: The overhead cover supplies a boundary with an upper and lower side.
Return or sending back supplies the boundary's active feedback function.

changed_reading.before: The sky merely contains a recurring phenomenon.
changed_reading.after: The sky is a return-bearing boundary that receives and sends movement back.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The packet's split inventory for the sky-word permits a visible-sign branch, while الرجْع permits repeatedly traced visual lines.
baseline_models.mechanism: Repeated celestial lines or marks can accumulate into a surface readable by signs; recurrence becomes inscription rather than only circulation.

activation_trace.role: A sign interpreted by discerning observation makes the sky a potentially legible surface.
Repeated visual lines supply the act of retracing through which a sign becomes patterned.

changed_reading.before: The sky's return is an invisible cycle.
changed_reading.after: The return-bearing sky can be read as a repeatedly marked surface whose traces invite interpretation.

context_deltas.mechanism: At 86:11 the opening السماء returns from 86:1 and the noun رجع returns from 86:8. The clause therefore performs two returns while predicating return of the sky.

activation_trace.role: The first overhead-sky occurrence supplies the earlier term that reappears as the focus oath's subject.
The earlier explicit return supplies the action-word that itself returns in the focus ayah.
The focus sky receives and displays the first lexical recurrence.
Return or sending back names the process that the verse's own repetitions enact.

structural_cues: The exact sky noun recurs from the opening oath at 86:1 in a renewed oath at 86:11.
The exact return noun recurs from 86:8 at 86:11 after a three-ayah interval.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the two lexical recurrences; I treat their convergence as semantic iconicity, while ordinary thematic cohesion remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: The verse only describes a sky that has recurrence.
changed_reading.after: The verse enacts recurrence: both its sky and its word for return have already appeared and now come back together.

context_deltas.mechanism: A rhythmically struck night arrival is identified as a rising star whose light pierces. Joined to the focus canopy and repeated-sound branch, these cues produce a recurrent pulse crossing or striking an upper surface.

activation_trace.role: The overhead cover supplies the surface through which or against which the signal operates.
Repeated sound supplies the returning pulse rather than a single isolated event.
A measured or rhythmic strike gives the night visitor the mechanics of a beat.
The rising star locates the pulse in a recurring celestial appearance.
Light piercing by brilliance turns the beat into an optical as well as acoustic crossing.

structural_cues: The sky is directly coordinated with the night visitor in 86:1.
The repeated title in 86:2 is answered by the compact identification in 86:3.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies strike, rising star, piercing light, canopy, and repeated sound; I combine them as one pulsed signal, while separate acoustic and optical images remain possible.

changed_reading.before: The echoing-sky reading is a free acoustic possibility.
changed_reading.after: The preceding night visitor makes the sky's return a recurring struck signal, heard as beat or echo and seen as piercing light.

context_deltas.mechanism: A sign-bearing, retraced sky is placed beside guarding, directed inspection, testing that manifests condition, and hidden interiors. Recurrence can therefore preserve and return traces until what was inward becomes readable.

activation_trace.role: The sign read by discerning observation supplies the focus sky's forensic legibility.
Retraced visual lines supply a durable repeated record rather than a vanishing event.
Guarding and watchful preservation supply the retention function of the trace.
Directed sight or insight supplies the act that reads the preserved sign.
Testing that makes a condition appear supplies the transition from latent trace to manifested state.
Concealment in the interior supplies what the returning record eventually exposes.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from a keeper over every self to an imperative to inspect, then to a day when hidden things are tested.
The focus oath follows immediately after force and external aid are denied, shifting attention to what the larger system retains.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preservation, observation, manifested condition, and hiddenness; I infer that repeated sky-marks function as a record, while a purely moral sequence unrelated to the sky remains viable.

changed_reading.before: Repeated sky-marks are decorative or astronomical patterns.
changed_reading.after: The return-bearing sky can be a preserving trace-system: recurrence brings hidden states back into legible evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context gives a fluid driven outward, emergence from an interior interval, and explicit capacity to return. The sky's water-return becomes the macro-scale counterpart of a bodily sequence of origination, exit, and restoration.

activation_trace.role: The sky-cover's extension to cloud and rain supplies the large-scale fluid source.
Recurrent rain and water supply the macro-scale cycle against which bodily fluid is compared.
Reproductive water in the womb supplies the generative micro-scale fluid.
Liquid driven and poured in one impulse supplies the outward phase of the micro-cycle.
Passage to the outside supplies emergence from an enclosed origin.
Return to a prior place or state explicitly converts outward generation into a reversible sequence.
Effective capacity supplies the power that closes the outgoing-and-returning circuit.

structural_cues: The repeated passive creation statements lead into fluid, exit, and then the explicit phrase about returning him.
The focus returns to the same رجع noun shortly after that bodily return claim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two fluid domains, exit, return, and capacity; I supply the macrocosm-to-body analogy and restoration arrow, while meteorological and bodily returns can still be read independently.

changed_reading.before: The sky's return is only a meteorological recurrence.
changed_reading.after: The sky's water cycle becomes a large-scale model of origination and restoration: outward life-bearing flow does not preclude return to a prior state.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah mirrors the focus oath with the lower counterpart of the sky and a fissure that lets growth emerge. Returned water above and opening earth below become two phases of one vertical renewal mechanism.

activation_trace.role: The sky as upper cover, cloud, and rain supplies the descending pole of the paired mechanism.
Recurrent rain and water supply the repeated input to the lower pole.
The lower realm explicitly opposed to the sky supplies the receiving pole.
Soft germinating ground supplies the material capable of responding to returned water.
A plant splitting the earth supplies the upward release that completes renewal.

structural_cues: Ayat 86:11 and 86:12 have the same oath syntax: conjunction, definite cosmic domain, ذات, and a definite action noun.
The semantic poles are vertically opposed: upper sky followed immediately by lower earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies returning water, germinating ground, and plant-made fissure; I infer that the water enables the opening, while two independent oath-properties remain a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: The return belongs to an isolated sky cycle.
changed_reading.after: The sky's return is the upper phase of a coupled sky-earth engine: water comes back above so life can break through below.

context_deltas.mechanism: The split sky-root inventory links early rain to marking earth with vegetation; الرجْع makes that rain recurrent, the earth opens for plants, and the following saying-branch allows the visible result to signify. Weather becomes repeated inscription on the opposite surface.

activation_trace.role: First rain marking earth with growth supplies the literal mark and joins sky-water to vegetation.
Cyclic rain and water make the vegetative mark recurrent rather than singular.
Soft productive ground supplies the surface on which the returning rain leaves a living mark.
Vegetation splitting the ground makes the rain-mark visibly emerge.
A thing's indication as its saying supplies the semiotic function of the visible growth.

structural_cues: The sky-return and earth-fissure clauses are adjacent and formally mirrored.
The assertion about a saying follows immediately after the two material processes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rain that marks with growth, recurring water, emerging plants, and nonverbal indication; I call their sequence an inscription, while ordinary ecology without semiotic force remains possible.

changed_reading.before: The sky bears generic recurring marks.
changed_reading.after: Its return repeatedly writes on the earth: rain becomes legible when vegetation splits the ground and displays the mark.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus reply and repeated-sound branches are followed by a saying whose function is to expose boundaries and distinguish matters. The sky's return can therefore be heard as an answering articulation, not an empty echo.

activation_trace.role: A returned answer or reply supplies responsive rather than merely repetitive sound.
Repeated call, recitation, or thunder supplies the audible recurrence of the response.
A thing's own indication as speech lets the cosmic mechanism carry articulate significance.
A tongue that distinguishes matters supplies the response's decisive separating function.

structural_cues: The assertion إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلٌۭ فَصْلٌۭ follows directly after the matched sky-return and earth-fissure oaths.
The compact action nouns الرجع and الصدع form an audible pair before قول فصل names decisive discourse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reply, repeated sound, indication, and distinguishing speech; I let the scope of the following assertion reach back to the oath-images, while reference to discourse alone remains possible.

changed_reading.before: The sky returns an acoustically empty echo.
changed_reading.after: The sky returns an answer: recurrence participates in an articulation that makes distinctions rather than merely repeating noise.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending mirrors scheme with counter-scheme, then commands delay and closes with a split-root branch of returning or sending back. This activates الرجْع as delayed feedback: an outgoing act is allowed time before it is countered or returned.

activation_trace.role: Return or causing return supplies the focus model's feedback operation.
The first scheme supplies an action projected outward by one side.
The mirrored counter-scheme supplies a formally returned action from the other side.
Deliberation and absence of haste insert a temporal lag into the counter-return.
The non-dominant mapped branch of returning or sending back reinforces feedback at the closing word.

structural_cues: Ayat 86:15 and 86:16 repeat the same verb-noun construction with reversed agents.
Ayah 86:17 repeats the delay command in two forms before its final diminutive adverb.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored scheming, explicit delay, and a packet-mapped return branch at the close; I infer a delayed feedback law, while a local threat unrelated to the sky remains viable.

changed_reading.before: Sky-return is automatic, immediate, and purely natural.
changed_reading.after: Return can be patient counteraction: what is projected outward is given an interval and then met by a corresponding return.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant س م م mapping attached to the focus sky-word and merges aperture with visual retracing. It remains packet-anchored through the focus occurrence and the preceding piercing star, but downstream prose should label it a material analogy, not a lexical gloss of السماء.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus sky-word carries a packet branch for a narrow opening, and its الرجْع carries a branch for repeatedly traced visual lines.

activation_trace.role: A narrow aperture on the focus sky inventory recasts the upper cover as a penetrable membrane.
Repeated visual lines turn successive penetrations into a retraced pattern.
Penetration through a hole supplies the active piercing mechanics.
Piercing brilliance makes each aperture a luminous trace rather than a merely physical hole.

changed_reading.before: The sky is an intact cover across which a star moves.
changed_reading.after: The sky can be imagined as a membrane repeatedly pierced by light, with recurrent apertures drawing a retraced celestial pattern.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because the focus return branch concerns reversed or failed animal conception, not ordinary rain. It remains live because the context explicitly supplies reproductive water, outward flow, and plant emergence; render it only as a gestational analogy that includes failure and renewal, not as a settled denotation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sky branch includes rain and vegetation, while a focus الرجْع branch carries conception that reverses or fails to hold.

activation_trace.role: The sky's extension to rain and rain-produced vegetation supplies the ecological body of the analogy.
Reversed or failed conception makes return a gestational reversal rather than guaranteed repetition.
Reproductive water in the womb supplies the explicit bodily analogue.
The single outward discharge supplies the initiating reproductive motion.
A plant splitting earth supplies visible birth at the ecological scale.

changed_reading.before: Recurrent sky-water is a uniformly successful cycle.
changed_reading.after: The sky-earth circuit can be carried as a gestational cycle in which flow may issue, fail to hold, return, and emerge anew as life.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it personifies the named sky as a respondent and joins branches across designation, knocking, reply, and decisive speech. Every link is packet-backed and the oath is the focus anchor, but downstream prose should present it as a sonic-rhetorical activation rather than claim that الرجع simply means revelation or speech.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Within the focus phrase, the sky-word's designation branch can meet the returned-answer branch of الرجْع.

activation_trace.role: Name as raised designation makes the oath's naming of the sky an addressable call.
A returned reply supplies the sky's answering side of the exchange.
The rhythmic knock supplies the initiating call.
Speech brought into utterance supplies the exchange's voiced realization.
Speech that distinguishes matters gives the returned answer determinate force.

changed_reading.before: The oath names a silent object possessing recurrence.
changed_reading.after: The oath can sound like call and response: the sky is named or knocked, and its return comes back as an answer that distinguishes.

strongest_changes: The focus clause performs its own predicate by returning السماء from 86:1 and رجع from 86:8.
The creation-fluid-exit-return sequence turns meteorological recurrence into a cross-scale model of origination and restoration.
The mirrored earth oath couples returned water above to germinating fissure below, while the split sky-root inventory also makes growth a recurrent inscription.
The mirrored schemes and commanded delay preserve a distinct reading of return as patient counteraction rather than immediate periodicity.
summary.what_was_special: The packet lets one compact oath remain materially plural: water cycle, echo, boundary feedback, preserved trace, ecological writing, articulate reply, and delayed counter-return coexist. The split mappings on the sky-word are especially activating because they add visible mark and narrow aperture without displacing the dominant upper-cover reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal arrow from returned rain to the earth's fissure is reader-supplied even though the paired materials strongly support it.
It is uncertain whether قول فصل reaches back to articulate the cosmic pair or refers only to the surrounding discourse.
The و س م and س م م activations are packet-licensed but form-distant and require explicit exploratory containment.
The acoustic, forensic, and delayed-counteraction models may be rhetorical iconicity rather than direct lexical scope.
